en.headline: Woman found beside share bike in Yuen Long dies in hospital
en.dek: Police are investigating whether she crashed while riding alone or was involved in another incident after a passer-by raised the alarm just after midnight.
body: A woman found unconscious beside a suspected share bicycle in Yuen Long in the early hours of Sunday has died in hospital. Police said they are investigating whether she lost control while riding alone or met with some other mishap.

Hong Kong 01 and other outlets reported that a passer-by alerted officers just after midnight on Pok Wai South Road, near the Nam Sang Wai sewage pumping station. A bicycle believed to belong to a share-bike scheme was on the ground next to her. The stretch has a cycle track, a footpath and a carriageway running in parallel.
Paramedics found she had no breathing and no pulse. She was taken to Pok Oi Hospital for resuscitation and was later certified dead. Police have not released her age, name or home district.

Officers said a single shoe left on the carriageway is believed to have belonged to the woman. They are looking for witnesses, checking nearby cameras and examining marks on the road and the bicycle. No one else has been reported injured.

zh.headline: 元朗女子倒卧共享單車旁送院不治
zh.dek: 途人凌晨在壩圍南路報案，警方調查事主是否獨自踩單車失控，抑或涉及其他事故。
body: 一名女子週日凌晨在元朗被發現倒卧路旁、身旁有一輛懷疑共享單車，送院後不治。警方正調查她是否獨自踩單車期間失控，抑或遇上其他事故。
《香港01》等報道，途人零時許行經壩圍南路近南生圍污水泵房時，發現女子昏迷倒地，旁邊有單車。該處單車徑、行人路與行車路並行。
救護員到場時女子沒有呼吸及脈搏，由救護車送往博愛醫院搶救，其後證實不治。警方未公布事主年齡、姓名及住址。
現場行車路遺下一隻鞋子，警方相信屬於事主。人員正追查目擊者、翻查附近閉路電視，並檢查路面痕跡及單車。暫時未有其他人受傷的報告。
